label: No Flinch Dopplegangers
summary: Doppelganger 10 and Doppelganger 40 no longer go into their hit-stun when struck; stone status, damage and death still work.

edits.why: Doppelganger 10 (BO4) normal-hit branch: jal SetDopplegangerStep(Dop_Hit=0xB) -> nop (sotn_bosses doppleganger_10_hit)
Doppelganger 40 (RBO5) normal-hit branch: jal SetDopplegangerStep(Dop_Hit=0xB) -> nop (sotn_bosses doppleganger_40_hit)

vanilla.reason: Both locations hold the off bytes in vanilla BO4/RBO5 and the patch is a nop, so it is safe on vanilla.

notes: Source: sotn_bosses.ppf ids doppleganger_10_hit (BO4 0x425A8 5612070c -> 0) and doppleganger_40_hit (RBO5 0x414F8 d60f070c -> 0); decomp src/boss/bo4|rbo5/doppleganger.c (hitFlags 1..3 -> SetDopplegangerStep(Dop_Hit)). The separate stone-break step call right after it (0x425B8 / 0x41508, a0=0xC) is untouched. Not part of this hack and must be kept: Doppelganger 10 HP x4 (DRA enemy table 0xB08C, scarlet_symphony_2_* PPFs). Other BO4/RBO5 o->a bytes (Reawakened damage colours 0xA94/0x3779C/0x3837C and 0xB20/0x366D0/0x372B0, MP&Hearts 0xEE0/0x40F7C/0x414AC and 0xF6C/0x3FEB0/0x403E0, Alucard-Rebalance 0x41B04/0x40A38) do not touch these bytes. Not emulator-verified here.
